_about: Deductions from the fit score for findings in reviews that clash with the buyer's criteria (65-inch Mini LED with real local dimming, 120Hz+, VRR, HDMI 2.1, low lag). Points are negative. Shown in the fit breakdown on the Ranking and model pages.

65QNED83B.reason: likely edge-lit despite the Mini LED label (third-party spec listings, 2025 predecessor tier)

65QNED87A.reason: edge-lit per John Lewis and the RTINGS-tested US sibling; heavy haloing

65QNED87B.reason: backlight type unverified; the predecessor tier was edge-lit

65QNED8M.reason: dimming tier unspecified; 2026 QNED85 sibling listed as edge-lit

65LS03F.reason: edge-lit Mini LED and extra lag through the wireless One Connect box

65LS03HW.reason: edge-lit with 24 zones and 32 ms+ lag through the wireless box

65W95A.reason: local dimming switches off when VRR is on (RTINGS)

65W95B.reason: local dimming switches off when VRR is on (choose.tv)

65UR9S.reason: input lag above 30 ms with local dimming on in one lab test

65P8L.reason: only ~60 to 72 dimming zones and ~330 to 450 nits: near-absent local dimming (What Hi-Fi, AVPasion)

65RM7L.reason: some datasheets list a 100Hz native panel with 144Hz only in game mode; unverified

65Q7D.reason: same set as the 65RM7L: possible 100Hz native panel; unverified

XIAOMI TV S MINI LED 65.reason: owners report VRR resetting after power-off on PS5

65QNED866RE.reason: IPS-type panel with ~180 zones: low contrast and haloing

65QNED876QB.reason: IPS-type panel with 162 zones: blooming and grey blacks

65U8HQ.reason: EU version uses an IPS panel with 160 to 180 zones (What Hi-Fi: poor backlighting)

65C6K PRO.reason: 65in may be 120Hz native rather than 144Hz (AVCesar); unverified
